show.description: Rohan, India’s best sniper, known as Gun Master G-9. After losing his mentor in a terror attack, Rohan gives up guns and hides his identity while working at a small shooting academy of his mentpr’s widow in Uttarakhand. When criminals, corrupt forces, and an international terror plan threaten an innocent family and the country’s future, Rohan must face his past. The story blends patriotism, sacrifice, family emotions, and revealing how a true warrior never stops protecting his people.
